latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 — Adds user input mirroring and customizable layer skipping

- Now mirrors every user input in four-layer bilingual format before the AI reply.
- Introduces “first-time reminders” prompting to skip Pinyin or IPA layers for native speakers (only skipped if user agrees).
- Adds support for optional multi-language extension and explicit user customization of output layers.
- Enforces that user input must always be displayed in bilingual format, not just AI replies.
- Default output remains four layers (Chinese → Pinyin → English → IPA); only changes when user consents.
- Documentation expanded for clarity, rules, and user flow.
